This building has no gutters. Instead it uses a curved roof and a bowl like structure to collect rain water.

While I find it a little bit more than mildly interesting, I must say, I wish there was more information included. Do they just dump the rain water into the ground or do they treat/filter/etc it and use it for drinking or cleaning/showering? It's a very cool design, though.

There is a drain at the bottom, so I imagine it drains into the storm drain/sewer just like your gutters should. Draining it into the ground would cause awful flooding, and draining it to the storm drains or sewers allows it to be treated and reused.
My gutters just drain into my yard, tbh. I'm going to have to look into this design because I'm really curious as to what they're actually doing with the water.
